coverage.what: coverage C_d = occupied bins / K and normalised entropy H*_d = -sum p log p / log K, per dimension, counted over FILMS (one film = one exposure) with at least two bodies (the others are read by neither training nor validation); K = the bins observed anywhere in this bank, except bodies_per_film (five fixed bins). The bank states no projection angle, SID or magnification: a render's view (ap/lat) and pose index come from its name, a real film is one bin ('film').
